subject: Mathematics
topic: Transforming exponential, log and trig graphs
topicAf: Transformasie van eksponensiële, log- en trig-grafieke

items.q: The horizontal asymptote of y = 2^x + 3 is:
items.qAf: Die horisontale asimptoot van y = 2^x + 3 is:
items.explain: Adding 3 moves the graph up 3 units, so the asymptote becomes y = 3.
items.explainAf: Deur 3 by te tel skuif die grafiek 3 eenhede op, dus word die asimptoot y = 3.

items.q: The vertical asymptote of y = log₂(x − 4) is:
items.qAf: Die vertikale asimptoot van y = log₂(x − 4) is:
items.explain: The graph is undefined when x − 4 = 0, so x = 4.
items.explainAf: Die grafiek is ongedefinieer wanneer x − 4 = 0, dus x = 4.

items.q: The graph of y = 3^x is shifted 2 units to the left. What is its y-intercept?
items.qAf: Die grafiek van y = 3^x word 2 eenhede na links geskuif. Wat is sy y-afsnit?
items.explain: The new equation is y = 3^(x + 2); at x = 0, y = 3² = 9.
items.explainAf: Die nuwe vergelyking is y = 3^(x + 2); by x = 0 is y = 3² = 9.

items.q: The range of y = 2 sin x − 1 is:
items.qAf: Die waardeversameling van y = 2 sin x − 1 is:
items.explain: The amplitude is 2 and the graph is shifted down 1, so −2 − 1 ≤ y ≤ 2 − 1.
items.explainAf: Die amplitude is 2 en die grafiek is 1 af geskuif, dus −2 − 1 ≤ y ≤ 2 − 1.

items.q: The amplitude of y = −3 cos x + 1 is:
items.qAf: Die amplitude van y = −3 cos x + 1 is:
items.explain: Amplitude = |a| = |−3| = 3; the sign only reflects the graph.
items.explainAf: Amplitude = |a| = |−3| = 3; die teken spieël net die grafiek.
